scope: BEAR exit lane only; BULL and RANGE retain their R7 eligible candidate sets pending the combined final lock.

evidence_before_lock.target_observation: BB-recovery targets 1.70 and 1.75 repeatedly passed, while high-profit trailing arm/giveback dimensions changed little economically but fragmented the multidimensional plateau.
evidence_before_lock.mechanism_decision: Remove the nonessential profit-trail axis. Preserve the completed-4h recovery-failure checkpoint and full-position BB-recovery realization.

candidate_grid.economic_role: At the first completed 4h checkpoint, abandon a rebound that remains at least 1.75%–2.25% below entry and has recovered no more than 0.35–0.45 BB-position units. Otherwise hold only until a 1.66–1.86 BB-position recovery completes, with 24h as the absolute ceiling.

neighborhood.definition: Chebyshev distance <= 1 across the ordinal failure-return, failure-BB, and recovery-target axes.

selection_rule: Select only from a connected local plateau satisfying every gate. Rank by highest worst-calendar mean net bps, then expectancy retention, then drawdown improvement, then lower max-hold rate, then lexicographic key.
release_requirement: After R8 selection, lock one BULL, RANGE, and BEAR candidate with a complete shared entry+exit fingerprint before the untouched 2020 holdout is accessed.
